verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime with OpenAI-like serving endpoints and a headless server daemon, so inference-serving optimizations are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence documents disaggregating prefill and decode phases or any large-scale distributed serving architecture. Its serving capabilities, such as on-network endpoints and on-demand model loading, are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
